# Week 5 Monday Briefing — league-2 (Intuitech Fantasy)

**The week is effectively closed.** 14 of 15 Week 5 games are final. The only game left is tonight's LA @ BUF (Mon 10/12, 8:15pm ET) -- and it's this roster's own starting QB, Matthew Stafford, who plays for the Rams. Everything else below is confirmation, not a decision.

## Source and freshness

Primary source: the committed `weekly-report-week-5.json` fixture (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries, generated 2026-10-06T16:07:10Z), carried through Saturday's final-call briefing (2026-10-10-sat), which already applied a live Friday-practice overlay. Live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 5 is now complete (361 rows, all 32 teams). `load_player_stats`/`load_team_stats` give actual box scores for the 14 of 15 games already final. `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` confirms Week 5. No live source in this sandbox can re-project an already-played game, so the lineup table carries Saturday's numbers unchanged; actual results are added as confirmation only. Stafford himself has no LAR injury-report row, checked fresh this morning -- unchanged from Saturday.

## Start these ten (Week 5, effectively locked)

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays | Actual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs BUF (tonight) | 17.95 | 96.6% | 18.59 | pending |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @PIT -- FINAL (PIT 34-22) | 17.88 | 97.1% | 18.41 | 11.2 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @DAL -- FINAL (TB 24-16) | 13.73 | 94.5% | 14.54 | **31.5** |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs SF -- FINAL (SF 32-29) | 23.31 | 98.1% | 23.76 | 22.8 |
| WR | Drake London | vs BAL -- FINAL (BAL 30-23) | 16.40 | 96.4% | 17.02 | 18.8 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | @ARI -- FINAL (DET 45-21) | 12.60 | 94.1% | 13.39 | 19.8 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @ARI -- FINAL (DET 45-21) | 11.31 | 96.4% | 11.74 | 18.7 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins (Q) | @MIA -- FINAL (CIN 31-24) | 14.43 | 93.4% | 15.45 | 4.2 |
| K | Dominic Zvada | @WAS -- FINAL (27-27 tie) | 8.10 | 98.4% | 8.22 | 10.0 |
| DEF | Jaguars D/ST | vs PHI -- FINAL (JAX 19-17) | 9.47 | 100% | 9.47 | 2.0 |
| **Total (pregame)** | | | **145.18** | | | |

Bench: Tyler Shough (QB, played Sunday, 1.84 actual on 2 INTs), Isaiah Likely (TE, 32.4 actual -- see Watch list), Cam Skattebo (RB, 7.1 actual, fumble lost), TreVeyon Henderson (RB, 4.8 actual), Jalen Coker (WR, bye Week 5, did not play). IR: Jaxson Dart (season-ending knee).

## Results so far (context, not a decision)

- **Irving: 31.5 actual** -- 165 rush yards plus a rushing and a receiving TD, more than double his 14.54 if-he-plays number. The best performance on the roster this week.
- **Smith-Njigba: 22.8** -- 5 catches for 102 and a TD plus a 16-yard rush, essentially on projection.
- **London: 18.8** -- 7 catches for 118, over projection in a loss.
- **LaPorta: 19.8** -- 5 catches for 88 and a TD in his first week at TE since the 10/8 trade; over projection.
- **Jameson Williams: 18.7** -- only 2 catches, but both went for touchdowns (47 yards); the thin edge that kept him over Likely/Skattebo paid off.
- **Higgins: 4.2** -- cleared Friday's practice report fine (groin held up), but just 2 catches for 22 yards; the week's clearest miss.
- **Zvada: 10.0** -- 2 made 50+ yard field goals and 3 PATs, offset by 3 misses, in a wild 27-27 NYG-WAS tie.
- **Jaguars D/ST: 2.0** -- 1 sack, no takeaways, allowed 17 to a PHI offense missing Barkley and D. Smith. The best matchup on the roster on paper produced the lowest score -- see Opponent notes.
- **Taylor: 11.2** -- 45 rush yards, 37 receiving, no TD; quiet relative to projection in a loss.
- **Bench Isaiah Likely: 32.4** -- 11 catches, 94 yards, 2 TD, more than double starter LaPorta's output in the same game. See Watch list.

## Changes since Saturday

None. No trades or lineup moves since the 2026-10-10 briefing; the lineup above is identical to Saturday's.

## Watch list

- **Week 6 bye collision** -- Higgins (CIN), LaPorta and Jameson Williams (both DET) all bye the same week. That's the starting TE and both current FLEX bodies gone at once, with only Coker (WR) and Likely (TE) left on the bench to cover three vacated spots -- zero bench depth left over once Likely slides into TE. **This is the last Monday before the Wednesday 10/14 waiver deadline.**
- **Isaiah Likely** -- his 32.4-point week (11 catches, 2 TD) more than doubled LaPorta's own good game at the same position. One week is noise, but he's already the bench answer for Week 6's TE bye -- worth remembering before spending a waiver claim on a TE the roster doesn't need.

## Opponent notes

- **Tonight's BUF defense is without Ed Oliver (DE, Out)** -- one fewer interior pass rusher, a mild tailwind for Stafford's protection.
- **The Jaguars D/ST's matchup (PHI without Barkley and D. Smith) looked like the roster's best and still only returned 2.0 points** -- a reminder that a strong matchup raises the expected outcome, not the floor. No change to how future matchups like this should be read.

## Byes ahead (next two weeks)

- **Week 6:** Tee Higgins (CIN), Sam LaPorta (DET), Jameson Williams (DET) -- three starting-caliber bodies at once. Needs a waiver add before Wednesday.
- **Week 7:** Jaguars D/ST (JAX) -- only rostered DEF, needs a one-week streaming add.
- *(Outside the window, but coming right behind: Week 8 byes Zvada, Skattebo, Likely and IR'd Dart, all NYG, plus bench QB Shough's NO bye the same week.)*

## Caveats

- Lineup total (145.18, pregame) sits at the high end of the normal band, unchanged from Saturday since nothing moved and nine of ten games are already final -- actual results mostly confirmed it (several players well over projection), with Higgins and the Jaguars D/ST the two real misses. Ordinary variance, not a pipeline problem.
- No live source in this sandbox can re-project an already-played game, so every pregame number above is carried from Saturday's briefing unchanged; that briefing already matched the fixture's own `conditionalPoints` with no >30% discrepancy.
- Waiver names in the committed fixture are kicker-only this week and don't address the Week 6 WR/TE crunch -- no FantasyPros/Rotowire access and no view of the other 7 rosters in this sandbox, so check the league's actual free-agent pool directly before Wednesday.
- Jaxson Dart remains on IR (season-ending knee), not evaluated for the lineup.
